page: Microsoft Azure EC64eds_v6 is a memory-optimized virtual machine based on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. The instance is powered by an x86_64 Intel processor configuration delivering 64 dedicated vCPUs paired with 512.0 GB of system memory. This architecture yields a balanced 8.0 GB of memory per core, addressing large working sets directly in RAM. The instance does not feature graphical processing hardware.

Storage architecture includes 3,780 GB of integrated local NVMe SSD capacity alongside compatibility with Azure Premium Storage. The presence of dense local NVMe storage provides low-latency scratch space and temporary file operations, eliminating reliance on remote network disks for high-frequency interim I/O requirements.

With dedicated compute allocations and a high memory-to-vCPU ratio, the EC64eds_v6 balances density and operational throughput for sustained data processing. This hardware profile is aligned with memory-bound workloads, including large relational database servers, in-memory caching platforms, enterprise data warehousing, and distributed analytical engines.
description: Microsoft Azure EC64eds_v6 is a memory-optimized virtual machine operating on the Microsoft Hyper-V platform. Driven by an x86_64 Intel processor, the server offers 64 dedicated vCPUs alongside 512 GB of system memory, establishing an 8 GB per core resource density. The hardware profile integrates 3,780 GB of high-speed local NVMe SSD storage and offers compatibility with Premium Storage tiers, catering to I/O-intensive operations requiring low latency. Graphical processing units are not included in this build. Resource distribution pairs high-capacity volatile memory with substantial localized non-volatile storage, enabling efficient execution of large transactional datasets and caching tiers. This architecture is designed for memory-intensive enterprise workloads, including large-scale relational databases, in-memory caching solutions, enterprise data warehousing, and distributed real-time analytics engines that benefit from direct access to fast local scratch storage.
